description: Reads a business's homepage and up to four of its booking, menu or price pages, finds the booking or ordering tools it links to or embeds (OpenTable, Resy, Booksy, Fresha, Vagaro, Square, Jobber and about 35 others), and says for Google AI Mode, Google's Book button, ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity whether they can book or order through those tools (yes, no or unclear, with the source of each yes and the countries it applies to). Also says whether prices are on the site, since Google's AI may phone a business to ask. Only sees the website. Limited to 30 checks an hour per caller (shared with the other checks); results are cached for 10 minutes.

url.description: the website or page, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/page

name: check_ai_booking
title: Can customers book this business through AI?
